script_text: Stop right there, Pisces — the cosmos just hit you with a major activation. Saturn is forming a precise square to your ruling Neptune in the 12th House, pressing the Water element and stirring unresolved emotions and deeply hidden patterns to the surface. Meanwhile, the Sun in Leo is conjunct your 9th House of Philosophy, fueling a hunger for truth that demands you act now. Venus trines your 5th House of Romance, opening a window for a deep intuitive connection — if you're single, trust that pull toward someone unexpected. Jupiter opposes Pluto in your 2nd House of Income, so a financial conversation or contract could shift your earnings this week. Avoid making impulsive emotional purchases today — the unexpected blessing is an old friend reaching out with an opportunity you did not see coming. Follow so you don't miss tomorrow's powerful alignment.
